deployments_detail.use: Field trial deploying NVIDIA GPUs at Comcast regional edge facilities (on DOCSIS 4.0 FDX nodes, smart amplifiers, intelligent gateways) for low-latency AI inference, with three initial use cases: a personalized ad-delivery engine (Decart real-time video models), an AI small-business concierge/front-desk (Personal AI small language model on HPE ProLiant servers), and ultra-low-latency game streaming. [NVIDIA (GPUs), Decart, Personal AI, HPE]

AI-powered network optimization and management at the edge
AI-powered service restoration during commercial power outages
Named as a Google Gemini / Vertex AI customer/case study [Google Gemini / Vertex AI] [Google Gemini / Vertex AI]

Xfinity Assistant, an NLP/ML virtual assistant that handles customer inquiries and self-service troubleshooting via SMS, mobile app and Facebook Messenger, paired with RealTime Assist proactive service notifications.
